titles.title: หยุดนะ! อย่าขยับ เดี๋ยวรักหมดใจ

description:
After returning from military service, Min-woo attends a nude croquis class in his university major. The model is nothing short of perfection—a body and face that can only be described as god-given. Min-woo falls head over heels for him. As an ordinary, inexperienced guy, Min-woo is content just to have glimpsed him and occasionally enjoys “happy times” imagining his face and body. Three years later, now a webtoon artist who has just finished a project, Min-woo unexpectedly gets in contact with a famous nude croquis model through other artists.

[“Looking for a private nude croquis model.”]

*“Hello, are you really looking for a nude croquis model?”*

To his surprise, the model is none other than the same man he fell for three years ago. His excitement is short-lived when he realizes something strange—why isn’t the model posing? And why is he coming toward Min-woo… undressing him? A chaotic and steamy romance unfolds between the openly perverted Si-hoo and subtly kinky Min-woo.
